integrity: Standalone verifier recreates 196226 faces, an acyclic 98087-pair matching, full integer Morse boundary, and 21 unit Smith factors; numerical certificates are paired with a homotopy argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite 32-vertex classification; no all-cycle torsion-freeness theorem or group-representation classification. Originality remains qualified by unindexed or unexpectedly subsuming prior results. No independent scientific audit.
title: Integral homotopy of the eight-cycle four-color categorical-product independence complex
